title: Healthcare financing summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data figures (CC-BY): government health spending below 1% of GDP in 1880, above 2% by 1970 in high-income countries; in the US in 2009 the top 5% of spenders were almost half of spending and the top 1% more than 20%. Complements added and verified consistent (1% to 2% is about doubling; top 1% is a subset of top 5%) before injecting 3 defects.
